# AgentToll

> 21 paid data endpoints for agents, $0.001–$0.008 in USDC, plus free discovery/status endpoints. The hosted service settles real USDC on Base mainnet. Base market and chain data always use mainnet even when a self-hosted service accepts Base Sepolia payments. No customer API key or account is required. Paying wallets and server facilitator credentials are secrets.

Service: https://agenttoll.app
Identity: agenttoll.base.eth
Source: https://github.com/tevfikefeaydin/agenttoll
This is the independent project at agenttoll.app; similarly named services have different operators and contracts.

## Payment and MCP

x402 v2 carries the quote in PAYMENT-REQUIRED, the signed retry in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE and the receipt in PAYMENT-RESPONSE. An unsigned request only inspects a quote. Handler errors before settlement are not billed; a lost response or timeout after signing can have an unknown outcome. Inspect the receipt/wallet before retrying.

The bundled payingFetch(privateKey, network, options) helper checks the registered endpoint ceiling, expected origin, network, USDC contract and recipient. The default session budget is 1 USDC per client instance; maxPerCallUsdc can only lower the route limit. The default total quote/sign/retry/body deadline is 30000 ms. Concurrent calls reserve budget atomically. Signed or still-signing failures stay reserved; cancellation prevents a late quote from triggering payment. Redirects, arbitrary routes and unrecognized payment methods are rejected.

MCP package agenttoll-mcp, version 0.13.0: 21 paid tools and two free tools. Run npx agenttoll-mcp without AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY for quote-only mode. Free get_payment_budget returns totalUsdc/spentUsdc/reservedUsdc/remainingUsdc and policy details; free get_payment_quote accepts a registered concrete path such as /api/price/eth, never an arbitrary URL. Set AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY only to enable payments.

Configuration: AGENTTOLL_URL (default https://agenttoll.app), AGENTTOLL_NETWORK (base or base-sepolia), AGENTTOLL_RECIPIENT (explicit trusted receiver required for custom origins), AGENTTOLL_BUDGET_USDC (default 1), AGENTTOLL_MAX_PER_CALL_USDC (optional lower ceiling), AGENTTOLL_TIMEOUT_MS (default 30000, allowed 1–300000). The hosted receiver is 0xe55359021a6a22d8385b827405991c56075f56f8. Do not infer a trusted custom recipient from a payment quote. MCP cancellation propagates to the payment request; budgets are in-memory per instance.

## Endpoints and paid tools

- https://agenttoll.app/api/price/{symbol} : spot USD price and 24h change; get_price ($0.001)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/gas?gasLimit={units} : Base gas, block and optional transaction-cost estimate; get_base_gas ($0.001)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/trending?limit={n} : market-wide trending assets; get_trending ($0.002)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/base/token/{address} : Base token price; get_base_token_price ($0.001)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/base/address/{address} : address snapshot with verified primary Basename; get_base_address_info ($0.001)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/base/portfolio/{address}?minValue={usd}&limit={n} : observed holdings and valuation with coverage; get_base_portfolio ($0.003)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/base/safety/{address} : automated checks with unknown evidence retained; check_token_safety ($0.003)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/base/scout?minLiquidity={usd}&pools={1-4} : sampled radar pools and safety results; scout_new_tokens ($0.008)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/base/fresh?minutes={1-60}&limit={n}&fundedOnly={true|false} : Uniswap v4 pool events; token attribution may be null and USD liquidity is not measured; get_fresh_pools ($0.004)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/base/radar/history?date={YYYY-MM-DD} : published snapshot pinned to immutable git SHA; get_radar_history ($0.002)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/base/scorecard?days={1-30} : latest published samples compared with current observations; get_radar_scorecard ($0.005)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/base/name/{nameOrAddress} : forward and verified reverse Basename resolution; resolve_basename ($0.001)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/feargreed?days={1-30} : sentiment and optional history; get_fear_greed ($0.001)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/base/trending?limit={n} : trending DEX pools; get_base_trending_pools ($0.002)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/brief?symbols={a,b,c} : prices, Base gas and sentiment; get_market_brief ($0.005)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/base/radar?minLiquidity={usd}&limit={n} : ranked new-pool listing, default $10k liquidity floor; get_new_token_radar ($0.003)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/try/premium?asset={btc|eth|usdt|usdc} : crypto-implied versus official USD/TRY; get_try_premium ($0.002)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/try/spread?asset={btc|usdt} : Turkish exchange quotes versus global USD price; get_try_spread ($0.002)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/watch/address/{address}?since={cursor} : paginated confirmed transactions; watch_base_address ($0.002)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/watch/radar?since={iso} : newer observations from the partial radar listing; watch_new_tokens ($0.003)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/watch/price/{symbol}?ref={price}&pct={threshold} : threshold status, no cursor; watch_price_alert ($0.001)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/catalog : machine-readable routes and parameters (free)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/demo : static response examples (free)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/stats : onchain totals scoped to configured receiver/payment network (free)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/health : liveness (free)
- https://agenttoll.app/api/ready : bounded facilitator/Base RPC probe, cached 15 seconds, 503 when not ready (free)

Optional parameters do not change prices. Invalid inputs return 400. Inspect source, coverage, partial and freshness metadata; provider data can be unavailable.

## Coverage and provenance

Wallet watches return an opaque cursor. Pass it unchanged as since, and drain hasMore pages before scheduled polling resumes. A call reads one provider page; coverage.complete/partial report whether the scan drained. The overlap is 120 seconds and cursor deduplication remembers at most 100 hashes; consumers should deduplicate by transaction hash. coverage.replayPossible flags possible replays. Older reorganizations, indexer gaps and arbitrary indexing delays are outside this bounded coverage. An initial ISO timestamp is accepted.

Radar watches use an ISO cursor over a ranked liquidity-filtered listing and always report partial coverage. Omitted or late-indexed pools can be missed. They are not an exhaustive event stream.

Safety cannot be clear merely because provider fields are absent. Unknown checks stay unknown; detected failures can still produce high-risk. No verdict guarantees safety. Reverse Basenames are forward-verified against the original address.

Scorecard days selects the latest N published snapshot days, not a calendar lookback or a fixed return horizon. First-sighting holding periods vary. Missing snapshots, unassessed pools and unavailable current quotes are reported separately. Null price changes/outcomes are not losses. liquidityGone=true means observed liquidity below $100 in the selected provider pair, not proof all liquidity vanished. Medians use priced rows only.

History/index reads are pinned to provenance.revision, an immutable git SHA. It identifies published bytes. A payment receipt does not authenticate snapshot contents or prove capture time.

## Response and deployment contract

Data responses include meta.requestId, servedAt, observedAt, ageSeconds, dataNetwork and paymentNetwork; unknown timestamps/ages are null. X-Request-Id identifies the HTTP request. Errors include error, code, retryable, retryAfter and requestId. Rate limits return 429; upstream failures 502; deadlines 504. An unknown settlement outcome can return paymentOutcome: "unknown" and retryable: false. Read Retry-After before a retry and inspect signed-payment state first.

Server ADDRESS is mandatory. NETWORK accepts base-sepolia (default) or base and controls payment only. Default mainnet settlement requires CDP_API_KEY_ID and CDP_API_KEY_SECRET. PUBLIC_URL declares the public service URL; TRUST_PROXY must match the actual proxy topology. REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS defaults to 25000. Per-instance IP limits are 60 free API/discovery and 600 paid-route requests per minute, including quotes/retries; they are not shared across deployments.

The browser demo supports quote-derived Base/Base Sepolia selection. Self-hosted receiver/network configuration comes from the same-origin agent card; quote terms are checked before signing. TypeScript examples default to localhost and may use public ADDRESS as recipient only there; remote custom hosts require AGENTTOLL_RECIPIENT.

- x402 discovery: https://agenttoll.app/.well-known/x402
- Agent card: https://agenttoll.app/.well-known/agent-card.json
- MCP package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/agenttoll-mcp
